The bundled //# sourceMappingURL comment was stripped from maplibre-gl.js
since the corresponding .map file is not vendored (dev-only convenience,
not needed at runtime; avoids a 404 when DevTools has source maps enabled).

To upgrade: replace both files with a newer version's dist output and
update this file. No other module in the app references MapLibre's
internals directly except js/map/map-loader.js and js/map/map-engine.js.
